Source.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/2] Participants respond to each item on a 7-point likert scale

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/17] The ERQ (Gross and John 2003) is a 10-item measure designed to assess participants' use of two prominent emotion regulation strategies: cognitive reappraisal and expressive suppression. The cognitive reappraisal subscale contains six items (e.g., "I control my emotions by changing the way I think about the situation I am in")
